import sys, json, random, os, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
src = open('/workspace/tmp/t/fuzz.py').read().split('def run(')[0]
ns = {}; exec(src, ns)
rng = random.Random(3*7919+13)
m = ns['gen_manifest'](rng)
plan = ref_plan = __import__('ref').ref_plan(m)
rows = ns['gen_rows'](rng, plan, m)
os.makedirs('/workspace/tmp/t/work', exist_ok=True)
open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/m3.json','w').write(json.dumps(m))
open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/r3.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(rows)+'\n')
got = json.loads(subprocess.run(['python3','submission/ipv6_replay.py','replay','/workspace/tmp/t/work/m3.json','/workspace/tmp/t/work/r3.jsonl'],capture_output=True).stdout)
exp = __import__('ref').ref_replay(m, [r.encode() for r in rows])
print('diag got', got['diagnostics'])
print('diag exp', exp['diagnostics'])
print('acc', got['accepted_rows'], exp['accepted_rows'], 'dup', got['duplicate_rows'], exp['duplicate_rows'])
for i,(g,e) in enumerate(zip(got['segments'], exp['segments'])):
    if g!=e:
        print('SEG',i, g['window'],g['scope'],g['subnet'])
        for tg,eg in zip(g['targets'], e['targets']):
            if tg!=eg: print('  T got',json.dumps(tg)); print('  T exp',json.dumps(eg))
        break
# print rows referencing that segment's probes
seg = got['segments'][i]
pids = set()
for p in plan['probes']:
    if p['window']==seg['window'] and p['scope']==seg['scope'] and p['subnet']==seg['subnet']:
        pids.add(p['id'])
for n,r in enumerate(rows,1):
    try: j=json.loads(r)
    except Exception: continue
    if isinstance(j,dict) and j.get('probe_id') in pids:
        print(n, r)
